notes.title: Under Construction: Summer City Early Access Release April 30th 10AM Central
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Raven here. Hope everyone is having a good April.

I have been hard at work, and I'm happy to inform everyone that on Friday April 30th 10 AM Central Standard Time I will be opening up Under Construction: Summer City for an early access release! Under construction will be on sale for 25% off for the duration of early access as I diligently work on improving it in every way!  

I am aware that there's still plenty of bugs and the game needs a ton of work, however progress is coming along quickly and I will be ironing out all the wrinkles. There will be regular weekly updates every Tuesday.

Thank you all for your time and patience! Working on Under Construction: Summer City has been an incredible journey so far, I'm excited to share it with all of you.

-Raven
